item.title: Fourth Session (23rd of October, 2025)
item.description:
Event Details

The first Lyon NLP Connect meetup of the 2025–2026 academic year will take place on Thursday, October 23, 2025.

The meetup will include:

  • Short presentations by participants about their research topics

  • Presentations of collaborative projects

  • Birds-of-a-Feather (BoF) discussions on:

    • LLM-based agents
    • Information retrieval
    • Multimodal models

Participants who wish to present their work are invited to prepare a few slides covering the problem definition, research questions, and/or a summary of completed or ongoing work.

item.title: Third Session (24th of June, 2025)
item.description:
Event Details

The third session will consist of 2 parts. We’ll begin with a roundtable for new participants to share their research interests, followed by a Birds-of-a-Feather-style group discussion. This time, apart from PhD students and postdocs, we invite MSc students working on NLP-related topics during internship, as well! The idea is to discuss recent papers on the selected topics.

item.title: Second Session (24th of April, 2025)
item.description:
Event Details

The second session will consist of two parts, similar to the first. We’ll begin with a roundtable for new participants to share their research interests, followed by a Birds-of-a-Feather-style group discussion. The session will conclude with a coding workshop.

We are finalizing topics for both parts and encourage members to join our Discord server to participate in the discussion. To receive the Discord link, please fill out the form on the homepage (if you haven’t already).

item.title: About the Community
item.description:
The idea behind Lyon NLP Connect is to foster collaborations between PhD students in Lyon and Saint-Étienne working on NLP-related topics.
Most events will be held in person. 🎤

Participants

We are a community of 40+ members from universities, research labs, and companies, including Lyon 1, Lyon 2, INSA Lyon, ENS de Lyon, École Centrale de Lyon, LIRIS, ERIC, Hubert Curien, Worldline, and Wikit.
